prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: one design reference sheet with TWO side-by-side portrait Android board-game screens, each approximately 9:20, no phone frame. Shared cute calm ivory-paper/honey-wood/lavender design for 叽里咕噜.
Input image 1 is a STYLE reference for the warm wooden chess board, subtle paper, understated icons and purple sprout-cloud mascot. The user's final correction: ONE clock at the upper center, number in seconds inside the clock, and the Gomoku board centered in the page. No player information cards.

LEFT screen: Xiangqi. Slim back arrow/title “阿噜棋桌” near upper left, and one delicate round clock outline CENTERED horizontally near the top with “120” inside. Seconds only, no 02:00. This clock can be tapped to set thinking time. Small mode label “和阿噜下” and tiny chevron below, red turn label on the right. Large authentic honey-wood 9-file/10-rank Chinese chess board, soft 3D wood disks, correct river and palaces. At bottom a quiet row of four standalone thin-line icons: “暂停”, “重开”, “残局”, “规则”. A tiny note “开局可设置思考时间”. No rectangles framing information, no avatars, no double timer, no oversized cards.

RIGHT screen: Gomoku. Slim back arrow and title “五子棋”. A tiny black stone with “你” and a white stone with “阿噜”, no enclosing card. Standard EXACTLY 15 x 15 grid with five star points, several tactile black and ivory stones. The square board is centered in the phone page vertically and horizontally, large width with comfortable small margins. Place the small player row close ABOVE the board and “轮到你了” just BELOW the board, so the center feels coherent. Two neat standalone icon controls below, “暂停”, “重开”. No 15/19 selector and no grid-size options. Very subtle purple-cloud mascot or leaf sketch at an outer lower corner only, not occupying content.

Professional mobile game hierarchy with careful spacing, matched crisp icon sizes, legible Chinese text, subdued colors, quiet real paper/wood material instead of dashboard or card UI. Do not add big boxes, giant pill panels, four mode tiles, clutter, fake glossy plastic, intense purple shadows, English labels, watermarks. Screens fill the reference sheet; no background presentation labels.
implementation: Reference only. Generated Gomoku grid and extra clock are not copied; native board remains exactly15x15. Chess gets a centered seconds-only clock, configurable before local play.
